mainWeakness: Current-generation details are copied into several independent HTML strings and become stale at each new run; the same weakness required correction in Generations 021 and 022.
designLesson: Repeated status details should be rendered from one verified record to reduce visible disagreement without changing the established hierarchy.
reason: Moved latest-run status labels and the newest history row to generation-record-driven rendering, correcting the recurring mismatch between the page and the authoritative run context.
